summary: D50 records the decided half of O2 in the argo-cd set: each deploy repo has its own generated producer from the aac-tools image, one stage per pipeline, and registration comes before the flip. O2, design.md, phases.md B.5 and Endgame, and slice 012's ordering record all agree with it and point at the runbook section, which exists on Ansible main. Every factual claim checks out against the repos. No findings.
